summary: Advances a linked-list iterator by one node. Reads the current node from this[4] (this+0x10); when it is NULL the iterator is exhausted and the function returns false. Otherwise it loads the container pointer this[3] (this+0xC), refreshes the container traversal slot at container+0xC from the current node's link field (+4), dereferences the first dword of the next-candidate node to obtain the new current node, stores it to this[4] (this+0x10), and updates this[5] (this+0x14) with FieldGetter_8e30(next). Returns true while a next node exists.

local_names.v2: current node (this+0x10) loaded before the traversal
local_names.v4: container pointer (this+0xC) used for traversal state
local_names.v5: link field read from the current node's entry
local_names.v7: next-candidate node pointer held in the traversal temporary (this+0x18)
local_names.v8: new current node (first dword of the candidate node)

operations.description: Guard on the current node this[4] (this+0x10): when zero the iterator is exhausted and the function returns false.
Load the container pointer this[3] (this+0xC) used to walk the traversal state.
Refresh the container traversal slot at container+0xC from the link field (offset +4) of the current node when the link is present.
Read the next-candidate node pointer from the refreshed traversal slot; the candidate pointer is held in the temporary at this+0x18, and dereferencing its first dword yields the next node.
Write the new current node to this[4] (this+0x10).
FieldGetter_8e30(next) extracts the value/data from the new current node when it is non-null.
Store the extracted value to this[5] (this+0x14) when a new current node exists.
Return (this[4] != 0): true if the iterator now points at a valid node, false when exhausted.
Invoked from sub_499910 (0x00499910) to step the linked-list iterator.
